GET /.note: The home page is assembled from searchImages, getFeatured, listComments and getForumActivity.

GET /:forum_id/:id.note: Short URL of a topic: getTopic and listTopicPosts serve it.

GET /:forum_id/:id/:page.note: A page of a topic: listTopicPosts with page.

GET /:forum_id/:id/post/:post_id.note: One post in a topic: getPost serves it.

GET /:id.note: Short URL of the image page: getImage serves it.

GET /activity.note: Same page as the home page: see GET /.

GET /api/v1/json/images/:id.note: Superseded by getImage: the image page carries the same data plus per-tag counts, in one request.

GET /api/v1/json/search.note: Alias of the images search: searchImages already serves it.

GET /forums/:forum_id/topics/:id.note: The topic page: getTopic for the topic, listTopicPosts for its posts.

GET /images.note: The all-images listing: searchImages with q=*.

GET /images/:image_id/comments.note: An image's comments: listComments with q=image_id:N.

GET /images/random.note: A redirect to a random image. searchImages with sf=random gives the same image without a redirect.
